name: Lost in Space
description: After crash-landing on an alien planet, the Robinson family fights against all odds to survive and escape. But they're surrounded by hidden dangers.

videos.title: Bill Mumy visits the Jupiter II
videos.overview: In this special, Bill Mumy, the actor that played Will Robinson in the original 1965 Lost in Space series, visits the Jupiter.

videos.title: Bill and Max Lost and Found In Space
Impact
videos.overview: On the way to a space colony, a crisis sends the Robinsons hurtling towards an unfamiliar planet, where they struggle to survive a harrowing night.

videos.title: Diamonds in the Sky
videos.overview: Another crash brings more travellers to the planet as the Robinsons work to salvage their ship with help from their mysterious new companion.

videos.title: Infestation
videos.overview: Flashbacks reveal clues to Dr. Smith's past. The Robinsons contend with a new threat as the ship's fuel supply starts dropping -- fast.

videos.title: The Robinsons Were Here
videos.overview: The Robinsons make contact with another family of survivors, and Will races to protect his family after Judy learns what happened aboard the Resolute.

videos.title: Transmission
videos.overview: As the team builds a tower to signal the Resolute, Maureen investigates a planetary anomaly, and Will braces for a tough conversation with his dad.

videos.title: Eulogy
videos.overview: Maureen debates whether to share what she saw in the sky, Don leads a mission to find fuel, and the robot's presence stokes tensions within the group.

videos.title: Pressurized
videos.overview: While Dr. Smith moves ahead with his secret project, seismic activity wreaks havoc across the planet and leaves two teams facing impossible choices.

videos.title: Trajectory
videos.overview: Maureen finds a solution to the fuel issue, but putting her plan into action proves trickier than expected. Dr. Smith realises her cover is blown.

videos.title: Resurrection
videos.overview: Judy sets out to find Maureen, while Will and Penny lead an expedition to the caves. Dr. Smith pursues a new escape plan.

videos.title: Danger, Will Robinson
videos.overview: As the clock ticks down toward the Resolute's departure, the Robinsons scramble to get off the planet -- and out from under Dr. Smith's thumb.

videos.title: Shipwrecked
videos.overview: Seven months later, marooned on a watery planet, the Robinsons make a risky bid to power up their Jupiter, and Will vows to track down the Robot.

videos.title: Precipice
videos.overview: Penny and Maureen become trapped in a mysterious metal trench, and Don falls prey to a nasty toxin.

videos.title: Echoes
videos.overview: The Robinsons' dreams of a happy reunion fade when they realize something's very wrong aboard the Resolute. Smith seizes a chance to clear her name.

videos.title: Scarecrow
videos.overview: While Will searches for clues to the Robot's fate, John and Judy travel to the dusty surface of the nearby planet to help their fellow survivors.

videos.title: Run
videos.overview: John's predicament goes from bad to worse, sending Judy on a frantic race across the planet. Penny spies on Smith -- with help from an old friend.

videos.title: Severed
videos.overview: The fast-spreading contaminant leaves Penny, Smith and friends stranded in tight quarters. Will and Maureen set out with Adler to find the Robot.

videos.title: Evolution
videos.overview: John recruits an unlikely partner to help hunt down a secret audio signal intercepted by the ship. Will begins to suspect Adler is hiding something.

videos.title: Unknown
videos.overview: While Maureen leads a mutiny, Hastings visits John to deliver an ultimatum, and Penny tries to convince Will that his Robot has changed.

videos.title: Shell Game
videos.overview: Will and Penny scramble to hide the robots and figure out their next move. Meanwhile, Hastings amps up his war against the Robinsons.

videos.title: Ninety-Seven
videos.overview: The mission to save Scarecrow takes an unexpected turn, throwing the Resolute into chaos. Judy hatches a plan to get a ship to Alpha Centauri.

videos.title: Three Little Birds
videos.overview: A year into their mission with the children of the Resolute, Judy, Penny and Will scramble to find the titanium they need to get to Alpha Centauri.

videos.title: Contact
videos.overview: While Judy sets out to find Grant Kelly, Penny and Will explore a mysterious tunnel. Light years away, Maureen, John and Don hunt for SAR's remains.

videos.title: The New Guy
videos.overview: Scarecrow helps Maureen and John plot an engine heist. Judy returns to camp with new passengers. Will makes a startling discovery in the alien city.

videos.title: Nothing Left Behind
videos.overview: As the adults race to destroy all clues to the location of Alpha Centauri, the Robinson kids receive an ominous message from SAR.

videos.title: Stuck
videos.overview: After crashing on a boggy planet, Maureen and Judy contend with a massive salivating creature, while John and Penny work to free the trapped Robot.

videos.title: Final Transmission
videos.overview: The story of Don's run-in with SAR leads the Robinsons to an alarming realization. Will sneaks out on a dangerous solo mission.

videos.title: Contingencies on Contingencies
videos.overview: The Robinsons race to get help for Will, warn the other colonists and activate a secret defense system. Vijay tags along with Penny on a risky outing.

videos.title: Trust
videos.overview: As the battle for Alpha Centauri unfolds, the Robinsons and their friends risk everything to restore peace and pave the way for a better future.

awards: Nominated for 3 Primetime Emmys. 8 wins & 31 nominations total
